svg.title: Two checked cubes with no box whose eight corners match
svg.desc: At left are exact slices at z=0 and z=2 of the certified 11-cube. Blue is one and gold is zero. At right is a schematic axis-aligned box with eight blue corners, not part of the witness. The proof checks the avoidance for both 11³ and 16³.

g.text: Color a cube without eight matching corners
No such box in either checked cube: 11³ and 16³.
